plan.title: Drop Python from the @deftai/directive-content prepack and prove a Python-free greenfield install

narratives.Description: The npm content deposit still bundles the scripts/ tree, so installs carry Python even on the TS-native path. This story removes the Python-only tree from the @deftai/directive-content prepack and proves a greenfield directive init plus task check succeeds on a machine with no Python installed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Update the packages/content prepack config so the packed tarball excludes the scripts/ tree and any other Python-only source.
- Extend the content-prepack test to assert the deposit contains no .py file and no repo-root run shim.
- Run a greenfield smoke that executes directive init then task check and verify it exits zero with no Python present.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer installing deft via npm without Python, I want the content deposit to contain no Python files, so that directive init and task check succeed on a Python-free machine.

items.title: Given the content prepack, when `@deftai/directive-content` is packed, then the tarball shows no scripts/ tree and no .py file.
